framework_lessons: Scale and addressable markets still need funding.
assessment: Bitcoin direction is well supported over both stated horizons. HDFC remains an open decade-long thesis with weak interim ADR returns and real merger funding constraints. The GDP-income explanation confuses accounting concepts, and the production-peak thesis underweights drilling productivity. Lightning functionality is real; payment superiority and generated-code quality require more than demonstrations.
